https://www2.jobdiva.com/candidates/myjo: Overview  Client is seeking a Measurement Systems Software Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and deployment of software for industrial measurement and inspection systems used in manufacturing environments. This role focuses on C#/.NET software development, hardware integration, and the delivery of reliable, production-ready measurement solutions.  The engineer will work with distributed software applications that coordinate imaging, motion, I/O, sequencing, and data handling for product inspection and quality control. The role also includes evaluating and applying AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering workflows and productivity.     Core Responsibilities  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and support software for industrial measurement and machine vision systems using C#/.NET.  • Develop and support distributed measurement system applications, including software communication, coordination, configuration, and data handling.  • Support software build, release, deployment, system integration, and technology transfer activities from development into manufacturing.  • Evaluate, adopt, and apply AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering efficiency.  • Contribute to best practices for incorporating AI development tools into day-to-day software engineering activities.  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and support documentation.  • Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use, support, and maintenance of deployed systems.  • Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for software and integrated measurement systems.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies  • BS, MS, or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.  • Experience developing software applications in C#/.NET for production use, system integration, or industrial applications.  • Experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting software for distributed, multi-process, or integrated systems.  • Familiarity with software communication and messaging methods such as publish/subscribe architectures, message queues, or similar approaches.  • Experience with source control, software versioning, and build/release workflows using tools such as Git, GitLab, automated build systems, and package management tools.  • Experience supporting software deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support in development or manufacturing environments.  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.  • Interest in applying AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering productivity.     Preferred Skills or Experience  • Experience with WPF user interface development frameworks in .NET.  • Experience with motion control systems, cameras, image acquisition hardware, and integrated imaging platforms.  • Hands-on experience working with imaging hardware, cameras, measurement equipment, or related instrumentation.  • Experience applying machine learning or computer vision methods to inspection, classification, or measurement problems.  • Familiarity with databases, containerization, or high-performance computing environments.  • Experience evaluating, adopting, or helping define best practices for AI-enabled software development workflows.  • Knowledge of machine vision and image processing methods such as feature extraction, edge detection, morphology, classification, inspection, and metrology.  • Experience with machine vision or image processing libraries such as Halcon, OpenCV, LabVIEW, or similar tools.     Work Details  • 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule as needed.  • Up to 10% to 30% domestic and international travel may be required, with trips ranging from one day to several weeks.  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
